title: —Hello, Stephanos!
html_source:
Stephanos is just Stephen’s name transliterated from Greek, Στεφανος, meaning “crown, wreath, or garland.”

Recall Stephen’s Greek connections from his surname, Dedalus. Daedalus was a mythological craftsman of Crete, most known for flying with his son, Icarus. (flying with wings he made)

This whole Greek connection may be related to Stephen getting “his wings”, as it is essentially from here onward that Stephen truly recognizes what he is “destined” to be.
